plugins.name: jira
plugins.description: JIRA over one REST gateway — read, search, export, create, edit, link and comment on issues from Markdown, with task drafting, thread-aware comments, daily summaries, release notes, roadmaps and release test plans built on top

plugins.name: utils
plugins.description: Utility helpers for common development workflows

plugins.name: personas
plugins.description: Conversational persona skills — consult specific personas on topics they know deeply

plugins.name: dataforseo
plugins.description: SEO research via the DataForSEO API v3 — keyword research, competitor & domain analysis, SERP/rank checking, and backlink analysis

plugins.name: project-docs
plugins.description: Spec/ADR/plan documentation system — scaffold it, keep it in sync with the code, read the plan back as one table, optionally mirror it to GitHub Issues, and write it so a human reads it fast

plugins.name: payload-cms
plugins.description: Read and write Payload CMS content over the REST API — discovers each project's collections, blocks and locales at runtime, composes blocks and Lexical rich text, uploads media, and guards every write with a backup, a diff and a re-read

plugins.name: qa
plugins.description: Manual QA through a browser — scenarios derived from the ticket and the diff or taken from a list as handed over, written down as a scenario file with test data, preconditions and dependencies, executed by Playwright in a QA window that stays open between runs or in the user's own Chrome, optionally checked against the local database (withDB), every screenshot captioned with what it proves and a frame around the evidence, every execution kept under runs/<runId>/, reported as a pass/fail/blocked table naming the run behind each row, with reproduction steps

plugins.name: pair
plugins.description: Pair or a team across Claude Code tabs — one session drives, a navigator or several architects and testers review the plan, approve the gated items and verify the result; architects pick the profiles they weigh, and every verdict is recorded against one member and revision
